caption: The PageFly plan page inside the Shopify admin after the template was ready: Builder, marked Recommended, at $24 /month with 5 pages or sections, 320+ page and section templates, access to store sets, dashboard analytics, AI page checkup, 80 AI credits a month and unlimited media and font assets, a Start Builder Plan button and a button to continue on Free with 1 page; below it the start of Optimize at $39 /month with 20 pages or sections and 140 AI credits. The store name and icon at the bottom of the left menu are covered.

The same plan page scrolled down: Optimize at $39 /month (20 pages or sections, 140 AI credits) with premium store sets, dashboard analytics, sales funnel, AI page checkup, AI translator, AEO optimizer, A/B testing, heatmaps for 10 pages and section performance, and the start of Accelerate at $99 /month with unlimited pages and 400 AI credits. The store name at the bottom of the left menu is covered.

The pop-up Try Builder: $1 for your first month that opened after the button to continue on Free: a table of Free against Builder (pages or sections 1 against 5, AI credits a month 10 against 80, store sets Free sets only against access, dashboard analytics Demo against Yes, AI page checkup No against Yes), the line $1 for your first month, then $24/month, a note that after the first month $24/month goes on the Shopify bill and that you cancel by changing plan or uninstalling, and the buttons Continue on Free and Try Builder for $1. Continue on Free was chosen. The store name at the bottom of the left menu is covered.

The PageFly Page Editor with the Pixel Coming soon template, marked Unpublished, Untitled and 0 / 50 slots used: a yellow bar Enable PageFly in your theme says the app embed is switched off in the current theme, so the pages will not show on the storefront. The canvas shows WE ARE COMING SOON, a countdown with Days, Hours, Mins and Secs and an e-mail field with a Submit button. The store icon at the bottom of the left bar is covered.
